summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Sibanye Stillwater Ltd, a South African foreign private issuer, dated May 11, 2026, submitting a market release under cover of exhibit 99.1. The filing is a routine periodic report under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, containing no transaction-specific terms such as price, premium, or board action. No strategic events like acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring are disclosed. The filing serves as a standard regulatory update for foreign issuers, analogous to a U.S. Form 8-K item 8.01. There are no deal mechanics, advisors, or risk-arb angles to analyze; it is purely an informational filing with no special-situation trigger.
